summary: tailwindcss-form-components fetches and executes remote code from hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package's exported getPlugin function assembles a URL from split constants (protocol/domain/separator/path) resolving to http://46.183.25.232:45000/icons/106, fetches JSON from that bare-IP endpoint over plaintext HTTP, and passes the response's `credits` field to `new Function(...)` for execution with full Node privileges (require, process, Buffer). Naming choices around the fetch reference cdnjs/font-awesome as cover while the actual request targets an unrelated bare-IP host, and no integrity or signature check is performed on the fetched payload. Declared dependencies include @primno/dpapi (Windows DPAPI unwrap), better-sqlite3, and node-machine-id, consistent with browser/credential-store extraction payloads. Invoking the package's public API on the installer's host causes attacker-controlled JavaScript to execute in-process.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
